# firezone_clients (Data Source)

Lists enrolled Client devices, optionally filtered. Every filter is applied by the API, and setting several returns only the Clients that match all of them. Set no filters to list every Client in the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every Client owned by one Actor, for example to put all of a user's
# devices in a device pool.
data "firezone_actor" "jane" {
  email = "jane.doe@example.com"
}

data "firezone_clients" "jane" {
  actor_id = data.firezone_actor.jane.id
}

resource "firezone_pool_member" "jane_devices" {
  for_each = { for c in data.firezone_clients.jane.clients : c.id => c }

  resource_id = firezone_resource.field_laptops.id
  device_id   = each.key
}

# Headless Clients that have been disconnected since before 2026. Setting
# online = false leaves out Clients that are still on a long-running
# connection that began before that time.
data "firezone_clients" "stale_headless" {
  client_type      = "headless"
  online           = false
  last_seen_before = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `actor_id` (String) Only return Clients owned by this Actor.
- `client_type` (String) One of headless, gui, apple, android. Only return Clients whose latest session came from this kind of Client application. A Client with no recorded session matches no type.
- `firezone_id` (String) Only return Clients with this Firezone ID.
- `last_seen_after` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp. Only return Clients whose latest connection began at or after this time. A Client that never connected uses its creation time.
- `last_seen_before` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, such as "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z". Only return Clients whose latest connection began before this time. A Client that never connected uses its creation time. Combine with online = false to leave out Clients that are still connected on a long-running session.
- `name` (String) Only return Clients with this exact name.
- `online` (Boolean) Set true to return only connected Clients, or false to return only disconnected ones. Leave unset to ignore presence. This is live state, so the result can differ between plan and apply.

### Read-Only

- `clients` (Attributes List) The matching Clients. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clients))

<a id="nestedatt--clients"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clients`

Read-Only:

- `actor_id` (String) ID of the Actor this Client belongs to.
- `firezone_id` (String) The device's stable Firezone ID.
- `id` (String) Client ID.
- `ipv4` (String) The Client's Firezone IPv4 address.
- `ipv6` (String) The Client's Firezone IPv6 address.
- `last_seen_at` (String) RFC 3339 time the Client last connected, or null if it has never connected.
- `name` (String) Client name, as shown in the dashboard.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether the Client is currently connected.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether an admin has verified this device.
